items.difficulty_reason: Ideal equations x_i + sum f_ij c_ij = 1 lifted from B to a finitely presented B_lambda with the prime tracked along the colimit, then the scheme-theoretic image computed affine-locally. The interplay of clearing denominators, the directed colimit of algebras and the scheme-theoretic image is genuinely multi-step.
